name: 水感香氛温和沐浴露款
description: 冰蓝水感香氛沐浴露套图，白底主图到泡沫微距与口碑收口的完整转化链路

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, icy mist-blue gradients #D7E9F8/#EAF3FB for info and scene shots, deep sea blue #2E5C9E for the closing shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool soft studio lighting, gentle top-left key, airy translucent highlights, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: frosted pedestal, rippled white silk fabric and pale grey bathroom tile
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons with translucent water-sphere accents, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright pump-bottle presentation with a consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh aqua body-cleanse visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of glacier white #F4F8FC, mist blue #D7E9F8, deep sea blue #2E5C9E and charcoal text #2E3A45; cool soft studio lighting with a gentle top-left key, airy translucent highlights and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style with translucent water-sphere accents; clean high-end body-wash photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright pump-bottle presentation with a consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，白底干净合规。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, upright pump bottle centered, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, just a clean even margin around the bottle
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view, the upright pump bottle standing centered and fully visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the bottle. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace, only a clean even margin. 8K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background tint, no floating product without a contact shadow, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 主图一秒法则，承接首屏强化核心卖点主张。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, bottle standing on a round frosted pedestal
shots.lighting: cool soft top-left key with a gentle halo glow behind the bottle
shots.background: icy blue sheer-curtain backdrop with vertical light columns, gradient #EAF3FB to #C9E0F5
shots.props: one round frosted pedestal under the bottle
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper 40% for the headline block
shots.textZone: headline centered in the upper band reading 「{selling_point_1}」, sub-line below reading 「{selling_point_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle shown at a slight 3/4 hero angle on a round frosted pedestal. Cool soft top-left key light with a gentle halo glow behind the bottle. Icy blue sheer-curtain backdrop with vertical light columns, gradient from #EAF3FB to #C9E0F5. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, generous negative space in the upper 40% carries the headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and a sub-line 「{selling_point_2}」 in charcoal #2E3A45. Negative: no invented efficacy claims or numbers, no garbled headline text, no props covering the bottle, no harsh specular blowouts on the pump head, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.displayName: 洗后干痒紧绷分屏痛点
shots.intent: 放大日常清洁后干燥紧绷的痛点，引出产品解法。
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, identical straight-on view on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat and harsh, right panel soft and airy
shots.props: a small red X badge above each problem panel
shots.whitespace: balanced gutters between the two panels, no dead whitespace
shots.textZone: one short label above each panel reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}, two matched panels with identical camera and framing. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel: an abstract patch of dull, tight, dry skin under flat harsh light, rendered as texture only. Right panel: {product} with soft creamy lather in soft airy light conveying comfort. Both panels on soft mist blue #D7E9F8 with a small red X badge above each problem panel. The product occupies 50-60% of the right panel, balanced gutters between panels with no dead whitespace, one short label above each panel reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」. Negative: no recognizable model face, no fabricated before-and-after results or statistics, no exaggerated wounds or cracked-skin gore, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.props: a folded towel and a wooden bath tray, not covering the product

provenance.notes: 12 屏逐屏事实：1 首屏泵瓶立于冰蓝幕帘底座配卖点标题；2-3 「为什么选择我们」圆形图标栅格（图标位空白）与「沐浴不当」痛点格（肌肤干燥/成分粗糙/泡沫过多，其中两格标签重复自相矛盾）；4 痛点格续接「深层营润」标题；5 泵瓶悬浮于透明水球间；6 皮肤分层示意信息图（四层标注，属伪科学话术，仅保留抽象分层结构）；7-8 「留香保湿」标题配模特面部与浴缸裹巾人像；9 三枚编号水球（两枚标签重复）；10 白绸背景正面泵瓶；11 手捧泡沫微距接「口碑甄选」好评墙；12 三条匿名好评截图与会员二维码角标。品类判定：全屏主语均为泵压沐浴露/沐浴乳，使用场景为浴缸与泡沫清洁，文案与画面均指向身体清洁，故判护肤个护/身体清洁，不依源夹名。已剥离：品牌字标、模特面容（改颈部以下构图）、原文案原句、伪科学分层标注、好评截图文字与头像、会员角标与二维码、原平台店铺字样；留香/保湿等功效表述一律以 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位，圆形图标位与好评卡均为空白占位，未写入任何成分浓度、检测报告、认证或销量事实。
